g.text: Composite — a file system, with a recursive iterator
size() is the payoff: one call,
any depth, no loop at the call site.
render() never asks what kind of
element it holds. Each one renders
itself — which is the one thing
A link is its own 64 bytes,
size of its target. Any other answer
makes size() on a root double-count.
not the immediate children: a nested
directory is not one item, it is
